rule_or_requirement: Local candidates must finish the qualified line on at least as many matched cells as the selected control before a faster lap can justify advancement.
observable_information: At inference, four grayscale frames and pixel-only road, speed, and obstacle diagnostics; evaluator records finish, action, speed, road contact, and runtime.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Preserve frozen opening launch and fixed early steering; apply only persistent visible-bend braking above image speed 45; no straight boost.
expected_success_endpoint: On new matched tune cells, candidate completion at least launch-only completion; on a tie a shorter median finished lap, with actual preview activation.
falsifier: Candidate-only nonfinish, lower aggregate completion, invalid action or resource breach; on a tie no faster finished-lap median.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Exact ZIP comparison on tracks 1-3 by seeds 7012-7015, 12 matched cells and 24 episodes, 2000 decisions each.
resource_and_risk_gate: Local Linux CPU 2 CPUs, 2 GiB, 1800 seconds; held-out 7016-7019 and confirmation 7020-7023 stay closed pending sequential gate.
